title: Microsoft Purview DLP: aggregate alerts by user (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the PowerShell parameter exists, but Microsoft has not documented what setting it to true does. Presenting it as a verified enablement command goes beyond the reference's placeholder description. The roadmap facts and the explicitly qualified preview behaviour are supported.

claims.quote: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object

claims.claim: A new match for the same user and rule within the aggregation window is added to the same alert even if it has been closed.
